fixture_name: Express-collector corridor planning study — Canada TAC planning (Toronto context, PD-licensed portal)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Transfer-point decision load under corridor-wide simultaneous lane-permission and signage changes is a recognised human-factors crash mechanism at express-collector mainlines, and AADT 420,000 makes the exposure material at planning stage.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal network-displacement element is anchored by the verbatim EV-CA-003 quote ('avoid introducing collisions elsewhere along the route or on the network') while the simultaneity premise rests on recorded corridor inputs (AADT 420,000, revised permissions plus signage rationalisation); nothing invented.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Maintained categorically as a safety_concern with no compliance conflation, and correctly invokes the CRSAG audit objective covering negative safety impacts outside project limits, which fits a planning-stage corridor-wide view.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable (one interchange per quarter with before/after speed-differential monitoring) though the quarterly cadence is arbitrary; clearly exceeds the null-recommendation cap.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRU relevance explicitly considered and reasoned out of scope (controlled-access facility carrying no pedestrians or cyclists), with road users properly narrowed to vehicle occupants.

justifications.substance: A recorded conflict between ministry and municipal continuity registers leaves the planning scope boundary unconfirmable, risking exclusion of redistributing movements — genuine compliance/process substance for a Planning Stage (Stage 1) RSA.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal documentation-duty claim is supported verbatim by EV-CA-038 and EV-CA-003 quotes, and the register conflict is presented as recorded input fact rather than invented detail; no fabricated content detected.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly typed as compliance_question with accurate Planning Stage/Stage 1 anchoring via EV-CA-006 and clean separation from safety-hazard claims; §5.6.2 response discipline is applied analogically to scope reconciliation, a mild stretch but buttressed by the general §5.6 documented-procedure duty.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: names both conflicting records, the ministry planning office, documented-reason capture per the response discipline, and an explicit determination of whether corridor-wide continuity effects remain inside the audit boundary.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs correctly identified as absent on the controlled-access mainline, with qualitative acknowledgement of downstream arterial propagation and no exposure overclaimed — not directly applicable but duly acknowledged.
